This is because: 1) it's not likely that the item you're looking for will be on the 1st page, 2) you're probably looking for something in particular (not just browsing), and 3) there could be so much data in this module that the server will time out before it can retreive all/most of it. Only you, your supervisor, & those with “People Administrator” role are allowed to add people as your subordinates. Your supervisor approves all additions.
The company that owns the system should include themselves in the approval workflow for all people additions (even by other companies) because an “active” status requires a system license.

Inactive people cannot be assigned new action items, use the software, etc. It is used for people who no longer work for the company, never received a user license, or stopped receiving a user license. Their name remains wherever it was used while an active user.

If adding a customer or supplier as a contact, set "ASWER-User?" to "No". They won't get a user ID & password and people won't be able to assign them tasks. Their company LOCATION, COMPANY, & ROLE (official position) should be made first (in that order). Their company should be a child of ISR Customers or ISR Suppliers, which are children of ISR. Their official position should be a child of Customer/Supplier Roles. It's faster to copy an existing person that already has phone numbers & email entered and then modify (rather then add from scratch). By the way, you can say a person works at "The Parent Site" (for instance), & the local location will be linked (e.g., 2400 Grove…). You can also add a specific location & attach it to that person like M/S-350. M/S-350 would be added as a child location of the local location. You don’t need to put anything about the street address or zip code because the parent location supplies that data.
